artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan (2 waves, 2.75h): add project-number-inuse.sh to three fixture suites' dependency lists, retire three stale known-failures.txt rows, redeploy, and run the full gate set.

memory_candidates.content: When a shell test suite in this codebase is repaired, the repair is not complete until agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/known-failures.txt is checked for a row naming that suite. The roster is advisory-only (run-all.sh's --fail-on-new accounting reads it, but a stale row changes nothing and fails nothing), so a fixed suite silently keeps its 'real-defect|...|needs-owner' row forever unless the fixing task retires it. The roster's own header states it is the single source of truth for which suites are known-failing, which makes a stale row actively misleading to the next reader. Retire a row only on an OBSERVED 0-failed tally; where a residual failure survives, narrow the row's reason field to the residual instead of deleting it.
